# dsh-local-markdown-notes

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that puts a folder of Markdown
files into a sidebar panel inside the

Web UI: browse the tree, read, edit with auto-save, search
the whole folder — and keep the Git cont

ext of every file in view (status, diff against `HEAD`,
per-line blame) without ever touching the re

ery file in view (status, diff against `HEAD`,
per-line blame) without ever touching the repository.
The panel is local-first: files stay where they are on disk, nothing is copied, synced or uploaded.
## Features

- **Folder panel** — import any number of local folders (a Git repo or a plain directory); a
recursi

ve tree lists every Markdown file, one click opens it next to the conversation.
- **Edit with auto-s

ave** — the editor saves while you type, and keystrokes typed while a save is
already in flight are

not dropped (they are re-sent after the write settles).
- **Markdown rendering** — headings, tables,

lists, task lists, links, images, footnotes, callouts
(`> [!NOTE]`), strikethrough and fenced code

blocks with syntax highlighting (shell,
PowerShell, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C

/C++, SQL, JSON, YAML and more).
- **Outline beside the preview** — every heading is listed down the

right edge and jumps to its
section on click; a `[TOC]` line renders the same list inline.

s and diagrams, offline** — `$…$` and `$$…$$` are typeset with a bundled KaTeX, and
